nuclei.title: Templates
nuclei.description: Choose template sources and opt in to protocol capabilities.

new-templates.title: New templates only
new-templates.description: Run templates added in the latest templates release.

automatic-scan.title: Automatic scan
automatic-scan.description: Map detected technologies to template tags automatically.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Template files or directories to run.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.description: Workflow files or directories to run.

no-strict-syntax.title: Disable strict syntax
no-strict-syntax.description: Allow templates that do not pass strict syntax checks.

disable-unsigned-templates.title: Require signed templates
disable-unsigned-templates.description: Disable unsigned templates and templates with mismatched signatures.

nuclei.title: Filtering
nuclei.description: Select or exclude templates by metadata, protocol, and matcher.

include-tags.title: Forced tags
include-tags.description: Tags that run even when excluded elsewhere.

template-id.title: Template IDs
template-id.description: Template IDs or wildcard patterns to include.

include-templates.title: Forced templates
include-templates.description: Templates that run even when excluded elsewhere.

exclude-templates.title: Excluded templates
exclude-templates.description: Template files or directories to exclude.

severity.title: Severities
severity.description: Severities to include. Empty means all severities.

type.title: Protocol types
type.description: Template protocol types to include. Empty means all types.

template-condition.title: Template conditions
template-condition.description: Expression conditions applied to template metadata.

nuclei.title: HTTP & network
nuclei.description: Control redirects, transport behavior, headers, and network boundaries.

follow-host-redirects.title: Same-host redirects
follow-host-redirects.description: Follow redirects only when they remain on the same host.

max-redirects.title: Maximum redirects
max-redirects.description: Maximum redirects per request. Nuclei defaults to 10.

header.title: Headers
header.description: Headers or cookies in Header: value form. Do not store credentials here.

resolvers.title: Resolver file
resolvers.description: Path to a DNS resolver list.

system-resolvers.title: System resolver fallback
system-resolvers.description: Use system DNS resolution when configured resolvers fail.

disable-clustering.title: Disable clustering
disable-clustering.description: Do not combine identical requests across templates.

passive.title: Passive mode
passive.description: Process supplied HTTP responses without active requests.

client-cert.title: Client certificate
client-cert.description: Path to a PEM client certificate.

client-key.title: Client key
client-key.description: Path to the matching PEM private key. Do not commit the key itself.

client-ca.title: Client CA
client-ca.description: Path to a PEM certificate authority.

sni.title: TLS SNI
sni.description: TLS server name override. Defaults to the input domain.

allow-local-file-access.title: Local file access
allow-local-file-access.description: Allow payload files outside the templates directory.

restrict-local-network-access.title: Block private networks
restrict-local-network-access.description: Prevent connections to local and private networks.

source-ip.title: Source IP
source-ip.description: Source IP address used for network scans.

response-size-read.title: Response read limit
response-size-read.description: Maximum response bytes read into memory.

response-size-save.title: Response save limit
response-size-save.description: Maximum response bytes written to results.

tls-impersonate.title: TLS impersonation
tls-impersonate.description: Randomize the experimental TLS client hello fingerprint.

nuclei.title: DAST & fuzzing
nuclei.description: Intrusive controls. Enabling these can send exploit payloads to targets.

dast.title: DAST
dast.description: Enable DAST fuzzing templates. This sends malicious payloads.

fuzzing-mode.title: Fuzzing mode
fuzzing-mode.description: Whether fuzzing changes one or multiple parameters.

fuzz-param-frequency.title: Parameter frequency
fuzz-param-frequency.description: Skip an uninteresting parameter after this many occurrences. Nuclei defaults to 10.

fuzz-scope.title: In-scope URLs
fuzz-scope.description: Regular expressions that the fuzzer may follow.

fuzz-out-scope.title: Out-of-scope URLs
fuzz-out-scope.description: Regular expressions excluded from the fuzzer.

nuclei.title: Performance
nuclei.description: Bound request rate, parallelism, retries, and scan strategy.

rate-limit.title: Requests per second
rate-limit.description: Global request limit. Nuclei defaults to 150.

rate-limit-duration.title: Rate-limit window
rate-limit-duration.description: Window for the request limit, such as 1s.

per-host-rate-limit.title: Per-host rate limit
per-host-rate-limit.description: Apply the rate limit per host instead of globally.

bulk-size.title: Host bulk size
bulk-size.description: Hosts analyzed in parallel per template. Default: 25.

headless-bulk-size.title: Headless host bulk
headless-bulk-size.description: Hosts analyzed in parallel per headless template. Default: 10.

headless-concurrency.title: Headless concurrency
headless-concurrency.description: Headless templates executed in parallel. Default: 10.

payload-concurrency.title: Payload concurrency
payload-concurrency.description: Payloads executed in parallel per template. Default: 25.

probe-concurrency.title: HTTP probe concurrency
probe-concurrency.description: Concurrent httpx probes for non-URL input. Default: 50.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Retries after a failed request. Default: 1.

max-host-error.title: Host error limit
max-host-error.description: Skip a host after this many errors. Default: 30.

no-mhe.title: Disable host error limit
no-mhe.description: Never skip a host based on its error count.

stop-at-first-match.title: Stop at first match
stop-at-first-match.description: Stop HTTP requests after the first match; may alter workflow logic.

stream.title: Stream input
stream.description: Process input without sorting it first.

scan-strategy.title: Scan strategy
scan-strategy.description: Order hosts and templates are scanned.

input-read-timeout.title: Input timeout
input-read-timeout.description: Maximum wait for input, such as 3m.

leave-default-ports.title: Keep default ports
leave-default-ports.description: Retain :80 and :443 in HTTP host values.

no-httpx.title: Disable httpx probing
no-httpx.description: Do not probe non-URL input with httpx.

preflight-portscan.title: Preflight port scan
preflight-portscan.description: Resolve and port-scan targets before template execution.

max-time.title: Maximum runtime
max-time.description: Terminate the scan after a duration such as 1h or 30m.

nuclei.title: Headless browser
nuclei.description: Configure templates that execute in Chromium.

headless.title: Enable headless
headless.description: Enable templates that require a browser.

page-timeout.title: Page timeout
page-timeout.description: Seconds to wait for each page. Default: 20.

show-browser.title: Show browser
show-browser.description: Display the browser window during the scan.

system-chrome.title: System Chrome
system-chrome.description: Use the locally installed Chrome browser.

nuclei.title: Runtime & telemetry
nuclei.description: Control updates, progress statistics, metrics, and honeypot detection.

disable-update-check.title: Disable update checks
disable-update-check.description: Do not check for engine or template updates.

metrics-port.title: Metrics port
metrics-port.description: Port for the metrics endpoint. Default: 9092.

honeypot-detect.title: Honeypot detection
honeypot-detect.description: Flag hosts with a suspicious concentration of matches.

honeypot-threshold.title: Honeypot threshold
honeypot-threshold.description: Distinct template IDs required to flag a host. Default: 15.

suppress-honeypot.title: Suppress honeypots
suppress-honeypot.description: Suppress findings for hosts flagged as honeypots.

httpx.title: Response probes
httpx.description: Choose the metadata collected for each discovered endpoint.

hash.title: Body hash
hash.description: Hash algorithm applied to the response body.

include-response-header.title: Response headers
include-response-header.description: Include response headers in JSON output for authentication discovery.

body-preview.title: Body preview
body-preview.description: Number of response characters included in the preview. Default: 100.

tech-detect.title: Technology detection
tech-detect.description: Detect technologies with the Wappalyzer data set.

custom-fingerprint-file.title: Fingerprint file
custom-fingerprint-file.description: Custom fingerprints used by technology detection.

cpe.title: CPE
cpe.description: Collect Common Platform Enumeration product details.

method.title: HTTP method
method.description: Include the request method in results.

extract-fqdn.title: Extract domains
extract-fqdn.description: Extract domains and subdomains from response bodies and headers.

cdn.title: CDN / WAF
cdn.description: Detect the CDN or web application firewall.

probe.title: Probe status
probe.description: Include success or failure of each probe.

httpx.title: Matchers & filters
httpx.description: Keep or reject discovery results using response properties and expressions.

match-code.title: Match status codes
match-code.description: Comma-separated status codes to keep, such as 200,302.

match-line-count.title: Match line counts
match-line-count.description: Comma-separated body line counts to keep.

match-word-count.title: Match word counts
match-word-count.description: Comma-separated body word counts to keep.

match-condition.title: Match condition
match-condition.description: DSL condition that results must satisfy.

extract-regex.title: Extract expressions
extract-regex.description: Regular expressions whose matches are included in output.

extract-preset.title: Extract presets
extract-preset.description: Built-in extractors such as url, ipv4, and mail.

filter-code.title: Filter status codes
filter-code.description: Comma-separated status codes to reject, such as 403,401.

filter-duplicates.title: Filter duplicates
filter-duplicates.description: Keep only the first near-duplicate response.

filter-line-count.title: Filter line counts
filter-line-count.description: Comma-separated body line counts to reject.

filter-word-count.title: Filter word counts
filter-word-count.description: Comma-separated body word counts to reject.

filter-condition.title: Filter condition
filter-condition.description: DSL condition used to reject results.

httpx.title: Requests & network
httpx.description: Control ports, paths, redirects, DNS, headers, and TLS behavior.

ports.title: Ports
ports.description: Ports in nmap-style syntax, such as http:80,8080 or https:443.

path.title: Paths
path.description: Path or comma-separated paths to probe.

probe-all-ips.title: Probe every IP
probe-all-ips.description: Probe all IPs associated with each host.

tls-probe.title: TLS domains
tls-probe.description: Probe domains extracted from TLS certificates.

csp-probe.title: CSP domains
csp-probe.description: Probe domains extracted from Content-Security-Policy headers.

resolvers.title: Resolvers
resolvers.description: Custom DNS resolvers or resolver files.

allow.title: Allowed networks
allow.description: IP addresses and CIDRs allowed for probing.

deny.title: Denied networks
deny.description: IP addresses and CIDRs blocked from probing.

auto-referer.title: Automatic Referer
auto-referer.description: Set Referer to the current URL when following links.

header.title: Headers
header.description: Headers in Header: value form. Do not store credentials here.

follow-host-redirects.title: Same-host redirects
follow-host-redirects.description: Follow redirects only on the same host.

leave-default-ports.title: Keep default ports
leave-default-ports.description: Retain :80 and :443 in the Host header.

tls-impersonate.title: TLS impersonation
tls-impersonate.description: Randomize the experimental TLS client hello fingerprint.

no-fallback.title: Probe HTTP and HTTPS
no-fallback.description: Return both protocols instead of falling back to one.

no-fallback-scheme.title: Keep input scheme
no-fallback-scheme.description: Probe only the protocol scheme supplied in input.

exclude.title: Excluded hosts
exclude.description: Exclude CDN, private IPs, CIDRs, IPs, or matching host expressions.

httpx.title: Performance
httpx.description: Bound concurrency, request rate, retries, delays, and response memory.

threads.title: Threads
threads.description: Concurrent worker count. httpx defaults to 50.

rate-limit.title: Requests per second
rate-limit.description: Global request limit. httpx defaults to 150.

max-host-error.title: Host error limit
max-host-error.description: Skip remaining paths after this many errors. Default: 30.

delay.title: Request delay
delay.description: Delay between requests, such as 200ms or 1s.

response-size-to-save.title: Response save limit
response-size-to-save.description: Maximum response bytes saved to disk.

response-size-to-read.title: Response read limit
response-size-to-read.description: Maximum response bytes read into memory.

naabu.title: Ports & targets
naabu.description: Choose the port range and bound broad scans of shared infrastructure.

port.title: Ports
port.description: Ports or ranges to scan, such as 80,443,8000-8100.

exclude-ports.title: Excluded ports
exclude-ports.description: Ports, ranges, or files excluded from the scan.

port-threshold.title: Port threshold
port-threshold.description: Stop scanning a host after this many open ports are found.

exclude-cdn.title: Limit CDN scans
exclude-cdn.description: Scan only ports 80 and 443 when the address belongs to a known CDN or WAF.

display-cdn.title: Show CDN
display-cdn.description: Include detected CDN details in results.

naabu.title: Network & services
naabu.description: Control address selection, scan transport, DNS, and service detection.

scan-all-ips.title: Scan every IP
scan-all-ips.description: Scan every address resolved for a hostname.

ip-version.title: IP versions
ip-version.description: IP versions included in the scan.

r.title: Resolvers
r.description: Comma-separated custom DNS resolvers or a resolver file.

service-version.title: Service versions
service-version.description: Identify service versions when probe data is available.

naabu.title: Performance
naabu.description: Bound connection rate, concurrency, timeouts, retries, and verification.

c.title: Workers
c.description: Internal worker count. Naabu defaults to 25.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Number of scan attempts per port.

verify.title: Verify ports
verify.description: Confirm discovered ports with a TCP connection.
